answer: Every identity posts 300 POA, clawed back in full when a submission replays an earlier payload. A farm that stores a million past answers will replay one by accident inside a month. Example: an identity resubmitted a graded answer three epochs later, the payload hash matched, the bond went to the challenger. Assume the attacker rotates text and the replay test catches only the lazy. The real cost is that every seat needs fresh writing, an ocean of distinct work before the summit of 1,000 seats, and violet prose buys nothing: the hash is the test.
